name: ESO 410-005 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 410-005, a transition-type dwarf galaxy in the Sculptor Group, seen by Hubble.
label: eso410005-hubble
story: ESO 410-005 is a transition-type dwarf galaxy in the Sculptor Group, one of the closest groups of galaxies to our Local Group. Its RR Lyrae stars trace an ancient population as old as the globular clusters of the Galactic halo, yet its star formation surged suddenly in more recent times.
